Explore what is already inside NovaClient.

Practice & teamwork Fast Practice, Fast Actions, team panel

Fast Practice brings practice controls into your run. Hold the Fast Actions selector, pick an action, and release. The team panel keeps team actions close at hand.

Try the team HUD ↗
Reading the map Edge info, finish prediction, full map

Show freeze and jump edge information, estimate a finish, or pull up the full map. The minimap and death markers help you keep your position in view.

Turn on World tools ↗
Visual control Aspect ratio, zoom, particles, cinematic corners

Choose an aspect ratio, adjust the visible area, reduce particles and add Cinematic AD Corner shading. HUD elements have their own size, opacity and position.

Adjust the world ↗
Community & languages Discord, Twitch, English, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish

Show Discord presence, receive Twitch messages in local chat, and choose a supported language. Report translation mistakes or volunteer for another language through the community Discord server.

Explore presence controls ↗
